meta.title: Aura Seeker — Map of the signs

footer.aboutText: Aura Seeker is a humorous project by the RDF collective, “Rang du fond”: a collaborative map of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes Region's signs, photographed and located one by one by its contributors. This site is not affiliated with the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes Region.

home.heroLead: Funded works, schools, displays and signage: every sign located and photographed in the field.
home.appLead: One photo, the GPS position and a few tags: the sign appears on the map.
home.betaNote: Beta version for Android, published on GitHub: download the .apk file of the latest release.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.publisherText: Aura Seeker is published by {publisher}, on a non-professional, non-commercial basis. It is a humorous project with no link to the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes Region.
legal.contactText: For any question, or to report content:
legal.hostText: The site and its API are self-hosted by the publisher, on its own server.
legal.contentText: Signs, photos, titles, tags and comments are published by the users of the mobile app, under their own responsibility. Content that breaks the photo rules or someone's rights can be reported through the contact above to be removed.
legal.ipRegion: The name and logo “La Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes” belong to the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes Region. They are used here for humorous purposes, with no affiliation.
legal.ipPhotos: Photos remain the property of their authors.
legal.ipMap: The map background and the place search come from OpenStreetMap: © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the ODbL licence.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.intro: We want this site to be usable by as many people as possible. It has not been audited against the RGAA standard: this page describes what has been provided for and what is still a problem.
accessibility.doneKeyboard: Menus, forms and buttons work with the keyboard, with a visible focus indicator.
accessibility.doneLabels: Buttons without text and form fields have a name screen readers can read.
accessibility.doneThemes: A light and a dark theme are offered; by default the site follows your device's setting.
accessibility.doneLanguages: The site is available in French and English, and tells screen readers which language it is in.
accessibility.doneList: On large screens, the signs shown on the map are also presented as a list, next to the map.
accessibility.limitsMap: The interactive map remains hard to use without sight or without a pointer. On large screens the list repeats its content, but only for the first results; on small screens there is only the map.
accessibility.limitsPhotos: Sign photos have no description other than the title typed by their author.
accessibility.limitsContent: Titles, tags and comments are shown as their authors wrote them, without translation.
accessibility.reportText: If a page or a feature is inaccessible to you, tell us:

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.intro: This page explains which data is processed by this site and by the Aura Seeker mobile app, published by {publisher}.
privacy.siteNoAccount: The site is read without an account. It sets no cookies and uses no audience measurement or advertising tool.
privacy.siteStorage: Your theme and language choices are stored in your browser and do not leave it.
privacy.siteLogs: Like any web server, the one hosting the site may keep technical logs containing your IP address.
privacy.thirdMap: The map background is loaded from OpenStreetMap's servers, which therefore receive your IP address. Searching for a place sends them the text typed.
privacy.thirdPosition: “Use my position” asks your browser for your position: it is used to centre the map and to search for the signs nearby.
privacy.thirdGithub: The app's download link leads to GitHub, which applies its own privacy policy.
privacy.appAccount: An account is needed to publish: email address, display name and sign-in method (password, Google or passkey).
privacy.appSigns: Each published sign includes a photo, its position, a title, tags, an optional comment and the date it was added. This information is public, with your display name; your email address never is.
privacy.appPosition: Your own position is not stored: only that of the sign you publish is.
privacy.appDevices: The app keeps the list of devices you are signed in on, so that you can sign them out.
privacy.appGoogle: If you choose to sign in with Google, Google confirms your identity and your email address to us.
privacy.rightsList: You can ask for access to your data, for its correction or its deletion, including that of your account.
privacy.rightsSelf: You can edit or remove your signs yourself from the app.
privacy.rightsCnil: You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.
